color.note: Cool slate neutrals biased toward the indigo accent. Light is the primary theme; dark is designed, not inverted. Every text/ground pair named in a usage note holds 4.5:1 in both themes; borders, focus ring and status marks hold 3:1.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background behind panels; the main content column in Chat and Sessions.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, the inspector, chat bubbles from agents. Separated from ground by hairline, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts, the ⌘K palette and dialogs. Pairs with shadow-2 or shadow-3.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs at rest, code and log wells, kbd keys, the diff gutter.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Tint laid over macOS sidebar vibrancy (backdrop-filter blur 24px saturate 1.4). Never paint the sidebar opaque.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative separators: between rows, panels and the title bar. 1px, never 0.5px in Electron.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: input borders, unchecked controls, outline buttons. 3:1 on surface and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: descriptions, table cells that aren't the row's subject, sidebar labels. On ground, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, counts, the idle status ring. Still 4.5:1 on surface-sunken; never lighter than this for text.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only. Below AA on purpose; a disabled control also loses its border contrast so the state reads without colour.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indigo thread. Primary buttons, links, the selected sidebar item, the focus ring, the working status dot. 6.4:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active palette item, text selection, the user's own chat bubble. accent reads 5.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark lightens the accent, so on-accent goes dark there; never use literal white on accent.

tokens.name: working
tokens.usage: Alias. The kernel state 'working': a session is running. Pulses; static under reduced motion.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Alias. The kernel state 'idle': nothing running, nothing pending. Drawn as a hollow ring, never a filled dot.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Verified good: CI green the kernel checked, a merged PR, a hook verified to fire. Only the kernel may turn something ok. Text on surface and on ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for ok badges and the diff addition gutter.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: The kernel state 'waiting on you': approvals pending, a question in chat. Amber, never red. Text on surface and on attention-soft.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for attention badges, the approvals count pill, the 'waiting on you' banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, denied, killed, over budget; the Kill switch. Text on surface and on danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges and the diff deletion gutter.

tokens.name: parked
tokens.usage: The kernel state 'paused at cap': the subscription weekly limit was hit and work is parked until the reset. Always shown with a pause glyph and the reset time.

tokens.name: parked-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for parked badges and the cap banner.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Alias. Added-line marker and line numbers in diff views.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Alias. Added-line background in diff views.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Alias. Deleted-line marker and line numbers in diff views.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Alias. Deleted-line background in diff views.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Alias. The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the palette.

type.note: The system font. SF Pro renders through -apple-system on macOS; SF Mono through ui-monospace. No font files ship: the app targets macOS only and native type is part of the native feel. Sizes follow macOS control text (13px) rather than web defaults (16px).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-state and onboarding headlines. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles in the title bar.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, section headers in the inspector.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wright drafted a playbook for PR review duty.
styles.usage: Default UI text: lists, tables, buttons, inputs, sidebar items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; row subjects in lists and tables.

styles.name: chat
styles.sample: I found three PRs where you're the requested reviewer.
styles.usage: Chat bubbles and playbook intents. One size up from body because it is read, not scanned.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, token counts, meta lines under a row subject. Colour ink-tertiary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase group headers in the sidebar and inspector. Colour ink-tertiary. Never for buttons.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Streaming logs, diff lines, dedupe keys, file paths, the exact payload in an approval.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Session ids and hashes inside caption-sized rows.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcuts in menus, the palette and tooltips. Set inside a kbd chip on surface-sunken.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Controls are 28px tall in lists and 32px standalone, matching macOS regular controls.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its label; kbd chip padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inline gaps: icon to text, badge padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding horizontal, gap between buttons, row padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding horizontal, input padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, chat bubble padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, inspector padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main content column padding; the weave pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top padding under the title bar on empty screens.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: List and sidebar rows.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Standalone buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: Window title bar with inset traffic lights (Electron titleBarStyle hiddenInset).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Navigation sidebar. Collapses to icons at 56px.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand detail panel in Sessions and Approvals.

radius.note: Small radii. macOS controls are 5–6px; only floating surfaces go larger.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd chips, status pills, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list-row selection, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, chat bubbles, code wells, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The ⌘K palette, dialogs, popovers. Matches the macOS window corner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, the approvals count pill.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly borders. Shadows appear only on floating surfaces, and every shadow carries a 1px ring so it survives on a same-colour ground.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Hover lift on cards and the dragged board card.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: The ⌘K palette and dialogs.

duration.note: Short. The app must feel like a native control, not a web page. Streaming output never animates.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover colour, pressed state, focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Toggles, checkbox, badge state change, toast exit.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus opening, list reorder, toast enter.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The ⌘K palette and dialogs, the inspector sliding in, sidebar collapse.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: The working status dot's breathing loop. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

easing.note: One standard curve, an enter and an exit. The palette alone may overshoot slightly.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Anything that moves on screen and stays.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Surfaces appearing: popovers, toasts, dialogs.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Surfaces leaving. Always shorter than their entrance.

tokens.name: ease-palette
tokens.usage: The ⌘K palette scaling from 0.98 to 1 on open. Falls back to ease-enter under reduced motion.
